description: This file defines a Java class ReadableOrderProduct, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It includes fields related to order product details such as product name, SKU, image, price, and subtotal, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProduct
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a readable version of an order product with additional product details, extending OrderProductEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the product name associated with this order product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the product name for this order product.

methods.name: getSku
methods.description: Returns the SKU of the product.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU of the product.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path for the product.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path for the product.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the product.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the product.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the product.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the product.
